insight: OpenAI’s ~$3B deal to buy it collapsed July 2025; Google licensed the tech for $2.4B and hired the CEO, and Cognition bought the rest.
name: Windsurf
tagline: Agent-first IDE with the Cascade planning agent.
description: Agent-first IDE that pairs autocomplete with Cascade, a planning-then-acting agent. Strong terminal integration; good when the diff spans many files.

modelSupport.notes: Bundled subscription includes the model spend.

changelog.summary: Vendor corrected Codeium → Cognition: windsurf.com now permanently redirects to devin.ai/desktop, where the product is rebranded 'Devin Desktop' under Cognition.

edge: Cascade plans before it edits, paying off on multi-file changes — with a cleaner, less busy UX than rivals.
cons: Smaller extension base than VS Code
